definitions.full: H6813. tsaan [ צָעַן ] verb wander, travel (Arabic journey, go away ; probably connected with Assyrian ƒênu , Ethiopic , Aramaic טְעַן , Palmyrene טען , all load (beast, etc.) = Hebrew טָעַן Gen 45:17 ; Aramaic טְעַן , also bear, carry ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יִצְעָן Isa 33:20 travel , i. e. be removed, of tent (+ יִסַּע ).
